# Bruce Clark Decoration

> Painter and decorator based in Edinburgh, Scotland, with 26+ years' experience serving residential and commercial customers.

Bruce Clark Decoration provides interior and exterior painting and decorating, wallpaper hanging and Ames taping across Edinburgh and the Lothians. Rated 5.0 from 28 Google reviews.

Contact: 07591 141732 | Edinburgh, Scotland

## Services

- [Residential Decorating](https://www.bcdecoration.com/residential-decorating-edinburgh): Interior painting, preparation and wallpaper hanging for homes.
- [Exterior Painting & Decorating](https://www.bcdecoration.com/exterior-painting-decorating-edinburgh): Weatherproof painting for render, harling, sandstone and woodwork.
- [Specialist Finishes — Wallpaper Hanging & Ames Taping](https://www.bcdecoration.com/wallpaper-hanging-ames-taping-edinburgh): Pattern-matched wallpaper hanging and mechanical drywall taping and jointing.
- [Commercial Decorating](https://www.bcdecoration.com/commercial-decorating-edinburgh): Offices, retail, stairwells and rental properties, scheduled around trading hours.

## Areas Served

Edinburgh-wide, including The Grange, New Town, Merchiston, Morningside, Colinton and Stockbridge, plus Balerno, Linlithgow and surrounding Lothians for the right job.
